name: Tiled bathroom
about: Bright tiles ring around every word in a small bathroom.

name: Shower with the water running
about: Close glass and tile walls, with the shower spray hissing right beside you.

name: Inside the coat closet
about: Coats all around you soak up your voice in a tiny dead box.

name: Carpeted bedroom
about: A soft, quiet bedroom with carpet and curtains, talking from the far side.

name: Kitchen at midnight
about: Hard counters bounce your voice while the old fridge hums and drops ice.

name: Empty classroom after school
about: Hard walls slap your words back while the wall clock ticks in the quiet.

name: In the pantry
about: A narrow cupboard of shelves and tins, close and a little rattly.

name: Locker room showers
about: A long tiled shower room with the water running at the far end.

name: Family dinner table
about: Talking across the dinner table while plates and forks clink around you.

name: Public restroom
about: A big echoing restroom of tile and steel stalls, talking from the sinks.

name: Stuck in the elevator
about: A small steel car hanging between floors, the motor humming as your voice shakes a little.

name: Parked car, windows up
about: Talking from the driver's seat of a parked car, the street hushed behind the glass.

name: Inside a tin can
about: A small, nasal, metallic voice from inside an empty can.

name: Into a glass jar
about: Talking with your mouth in a glass jar: hollow, close and glassy.

name: Hooting into a bottle
about: A deep hollow hum with an odd nasal ring, like talking into an empty bottle.

name: Head in a cardboard box
about: A short, papery honk from a voice inside a cardboard box.

name: Shouting into an oil drum
about: A booming steel ring as you yell into an empty drum.

name: Under the blanket fort
about: Smothered, warm and muffled, hiding under a heap of blankets.

name: Inside a padded helmet
about: Your voice right at your ears, boxy and close inside a helmet.

name: Shut in a school locker
about: A tinny metal box with only the little vent slits to talk through.

name: Inside a goldfish bowl
about: A round glass bowl of water: glassy ring, a wobble and little bubbles.

name: Zipped in a suitcase
about: Packed in among the clothes, your words come out dull and stuffy.

name: Inside a piano, pedal down
about: Head under the lid of a big piano, the strings humming along with every word.

name: Inside a bass drum
about: A big round boom with a dull skin, like crawling into a drum.

name: Glass phone booth on the corner
about: Shut in a glass booth on a busy corner, every word ringing off the panes.

name: Whispering from under the bed
about: Squeezed flat under the bed and whispering, the mattress smothering every word.

name: Behind a closed door
about: Someone in the living room on the other side of a shut door.

name: Through the bedroom wall
about: A voice in the next bedroom, dull and boomy through a thin wall.

name: Through a thick stone wall
about: Only the low murmur of a voice gets through a heavy wall from the hallway.

name: Upstairs, through the ceiling
about: The neighbors upstairs, a boomy voice coming down through the floorboards.

name: Through the heating vent
about: A hollow, ducted voice from another room, coming out of the vent.

name: Outside the closed window
about: Someone talking out on the street, heard through the glass with traffic behind.

name: From inside the wall
about: A thick, boomy voice that seems to come from inside the hollow wall itself.

name: Down the hall, door ajar
about: A door left open a crack: the words leak out clear but thin from the hallway.

name: Outside the church doors
about: A sermon in a long stone hall, heard through the heavy front doors.

name: Just around the corner
about: Someone talking just round a corner of the corridor: dull, indirect and off to one side.

name: Up in the dusty attic
about: A low wooden attic under the roof, wind moaning softly round the eaves.

name: Down in the basement
about: Bare concrete and a low ceiling, with the old furnace humming in the corner.

name: Calling down from upstairs
about: Someone at the top of the stairs calling down to you, high and far.

name: Calling from down the hall
about: A voice from the far end of the hallway, slapping between the walls.

name: Calling from the backyard
about: Someone out in the yard shouting in through the kitchen window.

name: Speakerphone in the kitchen
about: A call on speaker from a phone lying on the counter across the kitchen.

name: Apartment stairwell
about: Bare concrete stairs ringing up and down five floors as you call out.

name: Garage workshop
about: A cluttered garage of concrete and tools, someone hammering and sawing at the bench.

name: Vast cathedral
about: A huge dark cathedral where your words hang for many seconds.

name: Front pew of a stone church
about: Close and clear in a warm stone church, the long tail rising behind you.

name: Back of the church
about: The preacher far away at the front, washed over by the stone hall.

name: Concert hall stage
about: Standing on stage in a rich, smooth concert hall.

name: From the theater balcony
about: An actor far below on the stage, heard from high up in the balcony.

name: Small recital hall
about: A sweet, even little hall for a solo singer or a speech.

name: Castle throne room
about: A cold, high stone hall lit by torches spitting on the walls.

name: Marble lobby
about: A bright, hard entrance hall of marble floors and tall glass.

name: Hushed museum gallery
about: A big hard gallery where every voice carries, and visitors whisper around you.

name: Up in the bell tower
about: A tall stone tower where the big bell hums along with your voice.

name: Choir practice in the cathedral
about: A whole choir of you rehearsing far up the nave of a huge stone cathedral.

name: Empty arena
about: A huge roofed arena with nobody in it: a boomy wash and a late slap.

name: Indoor swimming pool
about: Bright, splashy and very long, with water lapping at the pool edge.

name: School gym
about: Big, hard and boomy, with a long slap between the gym walls.

name: Rock cave
about: Dark, irregular rock walls throwing your voice back in uneven echoes.

name: Long road tunnel
about: Rolling echoes running away along a curved concrete tube.

name: Down in the sewer
about: Wet, hollow and rumbling away into the dark, water trickling past your feet.

name: Calling down a well
about: A tight stone flutter and the answer from the water far below.

name: Concrete bunker
about: A dull, heavy concrete room deep underground, the air vents droning.

name: Subway station
about: A tiled underground platform, trains rumbling in and doors chiming.

name: Street singer in the subway
about: A busker singing along to a strummed chord down the tiled station tunnel.

name: Underground parking garage
about: Concrete and a low ceiling: a hard, zingy echo off every pillar.

name: Down the mine shaft
about: Calling down a deep, dark rock shaft, water dripping somewhere below.

name: Deep in the catacombs
about: Narrow stone passages under the city, chains shifting somewhere in the dark.

name: Storm drain
about: A round concrete drain under the road, rainwater pouring in from a grate.

name: Shouting down a sinkhole
about: Leaning over a deep round pit in the woods, your shout slapping back from far below.

name: Empty warehouse
about: A big, bare hall with a metal roof, your voice booming off the far wall.

name: Factory floor
about: Shouting over pounding presses and rattling belts in a hard metal hall.

name: Aircraft hangar
about: An enormous metal space, deep and slow, built to hold airplanes.

name: Inside a steel tank
about: Clanging metal flutter that rings for seconds inside a big steel tank.

name: Inside a shipping container
about: A long, hollow steel box that booms and rattles with every word.

name: Rooftop water tower
about: Inside a big round tank on the roof, the wind whistling past outside.

name: Boiler room
about: A cramped room of pipes and tanks, steam hissing and pumps thudding.

name: Server room
about: Talking over a wall of roaring fans in a cold, bright machine room.

name: Corner coffee shop
about: A table in a busy coffee shop: chatter, cups clinking and the espresso machine.

name: Airport terminal
about: A huge glass hall of rolling suitcases, footsteps and gate chimes.

name: Casino floor
about: Slot machines chiming and chips clattering on a big carpeted floor.

name: Game arcade
about: Yelling over bleeping machines and dropping coins in a packed arcade.

name: Night at the carnival
about: Out on the fairground among the rides, game bells and a band organ far off.

name: In the stadium stands
about: Shouting to your friend in the stands as the crowd roars and chants.

name: School hallway between classes
about: Lockers slamming, sneakers squeaking and kids chattering all around you.

name: Whispering in the library
about: A careful whisper between the shelves, pages turning and the clock ticking.

name: Hospital ward
about: A hushed ward with a heart monitor beeping and soft steps in the corridor.

name: Busy restaurant kitchen
about: Calling orders over sizzling pans, chopping and clanging pots.

name: Laundromat on a Sunday
about: Washers sloshing and dryers tumbling in a bright tiled laundromat.

name: Building site
about: Shouting over a jackhammer, a saw and a reversing digger.

name: Open-plan office
about: Keyboards clicking, phones ringing far off and the air conditioning humming.

name: Brick alley
about: A quick fluttering slap between tall brick walls, with open sky above.

name: Under the overpass
about: A hard concrete underside, traffic thundering by on the road above.

name: City rooftop at night
about: Up on a roof in the night breeze, the city humming and sirens far below.

name: Stone amphitheater
about: An open-air bowl of stone steps that throws your voice back from all around.

name: Empty schoolyard
about: An open yard with a quick bounce off the school wall behind you.

name: Harbor dock
about: On a wooden dock, the warehouse wall slapping back and gulls calling overhead.

name: City courtyard
about: A square of tall buildings that flutters your voice between hard walls.

name: Across the parking lot
about: Calling to someone at the far end of a big lot, cars passing on the road.

name: Shouting down the street
about: A voice from a whole block away, thin and wavering in the open air.

name: Town square fountain
about: Sitting on the rim of a splashing fountain in an open stone square.

name: Rainy crosswalk
about: Waiting at a beeping crossing on a wet street, cars hissing past.

name: Walking off down the hallway
about: You talk as you walk away down a long hallway, fading into the echo.

name: Coming up the hallway to you
about: A voice far down the hall walks right up until it is next to you.

name: Stepping out the door
about: You head out of the room as the street noise swells up through the open door.

name: Walking into the cave
about: You walk deeper into a dripping cave as the dark swallows your voice.

name: Coming up the stairwell
about: Footsteps up a concrete stairwell: a ringing voice climbing toward you.

name: Walking away across a big hall
about: You walk off across a huge hall until your words are mostly echo.

name: Pacing back and forth
about: Someone pacing across the living room as they talk, left, right, left.

name: Toward you through a tunnel
about: A voice deep in a tunnel slowly walks out of the echoes to meet you.

name: Leaving down the alley
about: You talk over your shoulder while walking off down a brick alley.

name: Walking past an open door
about: Someone talking in a room you walk past: in one ear, in front, then gone.

name: A hall that never ends
about: A wash of reverb that almost never stops, your words hanging in the air.

name: Cathedral built for giants
about: A cathedral twice the size of any real one, slow and dark and endless.

name: Inside a dollhouse
about: A tiny you in a tiny living room, every echo shrunk to match.

name: Hall of mirrors
about: Glassy echoes scatter in every direction and shimmer like reflections.

name: Hallway that goes on forever
about: Every echo comes from further down a corridor with no end.

name: Held up to a seashell
about: Your voice curled inside a shell, the sea rushing faintly behind it.

name: Inside a snow globe
about: A sparkling glass dome where your words glitter like falling snow.

name: Sunken ballroom
about: A grand old ballroom at the bottom of the sea, every word bubbling.
